'''Nirittu Kotta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who at one [[Time/Legends|time]] acted as a partner to the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Ro-San Borokki]]. After suffering a wound to his [[Limb/Legends|thigh]] during an assignment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Vaxal]], Kotta sought medical treatment and was operated on inside a storage shed by a rusted [[DD-13 medical assistant droid/Legends|DD-13 medical assistant droid]] maintained by the world's planetary [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]]. However, rather than properly treat his injury, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] instead opted to amputate Kotta's damaged limb.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
